glosses: to grab, to seize, to grasp (to take hold of quickly)
to catch, to trap (e.g. an animal)
to take up, to employ (to pick up with the intention of using)
to take, to grab, to make the most of (e.g. a chance, an opportunity)
to sense, to notice, to perceive
to get, to grasp, to understand
to take, to catch on (to become accepted)
to grab oneself, to grasp oneself
to catch oneself, to notice one's behaviour
to hold on, to keep one's balance by holding
to get into, to throw oneself into, to become interested in

examples.text: Kobieta chwyciła go za rękę mówiąc: "Nie odchodź ode mnie!"
